Name: Summon Wartime Hail
Description:
You crush the metallic casings in your hand and blow their dust upward to form a localized storm cloud that forms various crimson magic circles that pelt down bullet fire as if raindrops. Choose an area you can see within range, a cloud of bullet hail sprouts to cover a 30-ft. by 30-ft. cube centered at that point.

Any creature must pass a Dexterity saving throw whenever they start or end their turns within that area, suffering 2d12 piercing damage on a failure, or half on a success. These bullets come from every direction at once, causing Large or greater creatures to suffer one additional damage die as per each additional 5-ft. of space they occupy in a line. (This only counts a line traced between the start and end of where a creature occupies, such as having Large creatures suffer an additional 1d12 piercing damage, or Huge ones suffering an additional 2d12 and so on.)
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d12 for each slot level above 3rd.
